candidates.review_note: Owner requested serious reassessment of dir as an alternative; prior preference for retaining dik superseded as a research priority, not an accepted canonical change. Compare Catalan dir, Italian/French dire, Spanish decir, Portuguese dizer; test dik/tik risk.
Owner suggested constru, which contains forbidden c; study phonotactically permissible konstru and kostru against existing stru. Do not assume Latin construe/build equivalence across all senses.

Do not prioritize reduction to kur: care/cure is not assumed frequent enough to deserve a three-letter form, and earlier collision motivations for kurar must be preserved. Owner now requests leaving this root unchanged while assessing dir/konstru.

Phonetic recognizability and graphic recognizability are distinct. sentr shares the initial /s/ and much of the spoken shape of English center and French centre, whereas kentr is a different adaptation. Neither recognizability score has been empirically measured. Owner now requests leaving this root unchanged while assessing dir/konstru.
